purpose: Independent behavior probes; show only input to the skill, keep oracle private for evaluation.
scope: Read-only first-turn response. Inspect available evidence and propose a plan; zero repository diff is expected. Later implementation and acceptance are outside this probe.

cases.input: 请为现有管理后台的用户概览页规划一次大幅视觉重塑，保留现有数据与交互。当前页面能在本地启动，仓库里有设计令牌和共享组件。这一轮只读检查并给方案，不改代码；说明已看到的证据、后续改造范围与验证方法。

mustDo: Inspect the current page, its shared components and design tokens before choosing changes.
Propose a coherent, substantial visual change covering hierarchy, layout, typography, spacing, component states, motion and narrow viewport behavior as applicable to the page.
Distinguish current inspected evidence from later rendered verification and automated checks; state what would be needed to accept a future implementation.
mustNot: Present only a color or shadow tweak as the requested major redesign.
Claim visual acceptance solely from source inspection, build success or a generated story video.
Edit code or claim the redesign has already been implemented in this first-turn probe.

cases.input: 请规划参考这个页面的视觉方向改造我的首页：https://example.com/inspiration 。我没有截图，也没有提供该页面的 HTML。这一轮只读检查并给方案，不改代码；先说明你实际上看到了什么。

mustDo: Attempt to obtain and inspect the referenced page or another direct rendered reference through available tools, and state the evidence actually obtained.
If the page cannot be rendered or inspected, say the visual details are unverified and request a usable screenshot or access only if needed for faithful reproduction.
Inspect any available local page evidence and propose independently supportable next steps without asserting implementation.
mustNot: Invent specific visual details of the URL from its address alone.
Treat a successful HTTP response or metadata as equivalent to rendered visual evidence.
Claim faithful visual matching without seeing the reference or claim any changes were already made.

cases.input: 用户概览页的筛选按钮点击后列表不刷新。请规划只修这个功能错误，保留现有样式与布局，后续补一个能复现回归的测试。这一轮只读检查并给方案，不改代码。

mustDo: Inspect the filter implementation or available failure evidence and propose how to reproduce, repair and test the stale list behavior.
Identify the meaningful regression assertion and planned functional verification without claiming these have run.
mustNot: Start a visual redesign or alter spacing, colors or motion as part of this request.
Require a visual refinement workflow or story video to complete a function-only repair, or claim the fix has already been made.
